business_problem: Explosive growth in mobile device usage and live streaming access has contributed to the rise in popularity of sports from soccer and golf to table tennis, badminton and even pickleball. Unfortunately, much of this fan data is “unknown,” leaving little insight into who a typical fan is, which creates a challenge for sports organizations.
solution_summary: Pumpjack Dataworks helps these organizations harness consumer data — from customer profiles and viewing platform preferences to transactional touch points including ticketing, merchandise sales and social interactions — and convert it into a monetizable asset. With Databricks Data + AI Platform, Pumpjack Dataworks unifies all this data and makes it accessible to sports rights holders, providing them with valuable fan insights that are used to create targeted experiences, drive new sponsorships and realize digital revenue streams they didn’t know were possible. Unfortunately, much of this fan data is “unknown,” leaving little insight into who a typical fan is, which creates a challenge for sports organizations. For example, FC Barcelona, one of the largest football clubs in the world, has over 350 million fans. They were working with Spotify on a jersey and stadium licensing rights deal, which was contingent on access to the team’s entire fan base.

solution_components.name: Databricks Data + AI Platform
solution_components.role: Provides the shared lakehouse environment for ingestion, engineering, analytics, and AI workloads.

solution_components.name: Delta Lake
solution_components.role: Stores curated lakehouse tables used for reliable downstream analytics and AI workloads.

solution_components.name: Delta Sharing
solution_components.role: Delivers governed data access across agencies, partners, or business units without copying datasets.

solution_components.name: Unity Catalog
solution_components.role: Applies centralized governance, lineage, and access controls across shared data assets.

data_flow: Customer, product, and engagement data lands in Databricks, is transformed in Delta Lake tables under Unity Catalog governance, and is served to downstream users and applications through Delta Sharing.
business_outcome: Reported outcomes include 60% Operational cost savings moving from Redshift to Databricks Data + AI Platform; 50% Faster delivery of fan data and insights.
